protocol.name: PIT protocol · publicinform
protocol.summary: Consent is asked out loud at the top, on the recording itself; nothing goes public until everyone on the call has said yes and the transcript has been checked; takedown comes first, questions second.
protocol.growing: Every blessed recording and transcript becomes a public media file at /meetings/. Record your circle the same way, ask consent on the recording, and add yours.

channels.title: Proposal Meeting #1 · The First Circle
channels.subtitle: Devcon 8 retro and the road to Lisbon · Session A
channels.lede: Shaka opens the first proposal circle after Devcon 8 with Ben, Levi and Utkarsh: how a no-commission orchestra might one day fund flights, housing and a shared backline retroactively and equally, from EthCC in Cannes to Devcon 9 in Lisbon. Levi describes his co-op’s approach to rights and revenue splits, Utkarsh’s x402 agent-tipping work is recapped, and the circle agrees only to keep talking — the DAO stays a proposal, in Shaka’s words “just a prayer.”
